definition.quote: GMV is the total dollar value of orders facilitated through our platform including certain apps and channels for which a revenue-sharing arrangement is in place in the period, net of refunds, and inclusive of shipping and handling, duty and value-added taxes. GMV does not represent revenue earned by us.

ecosystem.notes: GMV includes shipping, duties and VAT, and is net of refunds. Shopify's revenue includes subscription fees as well as payment processing fees. Shopify Payments carried $181.0B of the GMV (61.9% penetration). The 10-K says 'over 57% of our GMV was generated in the United States'. The FY2024 original 10-K was used, not the 10-K/A filed 2025-04-29.
